texts.content: DesktopAssistant Integrated  |  Power and MCU / 配电与主控
Two external regulator modules; outputs are separate. Set both to 5.0V before connection.
ESP32-S3 carrier sockets / 保留已核对的开发板针序
MCU 5V isolated by JP_MCU; OPEN during USB debugging.
Each module connector: pin 1 positive, pin 2 GND. Modules are external, not on-board footprints.
J_SW is a cable interface, not a diode. Use a DC-rated switch appropriate for servo startup current.
